title: The Dreamer's First Primer
summary: A first primer for the dream-aligned that teaches the drowsing touch and the first ways to lull a foe and rest an ally.

title: A Handbook of Light Sleep
summary: A handbook of light sleep that uses a breath of mist and a slow drift to dull a foe and to ease an ally.

title: The Drowsy Reverie Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on drawing a foe's attention away into a daydream and keeping one's own mind clear.

title: Elementary Dream Walking
summary: An elementary course in walking half in the dream layer where the body blurs and a sleeper's mind can be touched.

title: The Sleeper's Companion
summary: A short companion for the one who keeps watch over a sleeper and guards the sleeper's rest.

title: A Workbook of Waking Dreams
summary: A workbook of dreams played out wide awake that teaches the dreamer to confuse a foe and to tell dream from fact.
